The top-level scope contains only safe variable assignments and URL construction without side effects. No network requests or file operations beyond the intended source download occur during sourcing.

Since `makepkg --nobuild --nodeps --noprepare` will only source the PKGBUILD, resolve the source URLs, and download the tarballs (without extracting or running anything), and because no malicious code execution occurs during sourcing, this operation is safe.
</details>
